reviews.text: This holder is just what we need for our Oral B iO toothbrush heads. It holds the heads so that any water that gets inside can drain out, hopefully preventing any mold build up. I contacted the seller to make sure this holder would fit our toothbrush heads, and he responded immediately, assuring me he could make one to fit our particular toothbrush heads. He was kind and patient with all my questions. The holder is well made, and the seller packed it with great care for shipping. It arrived in excellent condition. I highly recommend this toothbrush head holder and this seller!
